results.name: Atomic settlement applies wallets, research, stats and prestige
Insufficient balances block the entire settlement
Explicit IDs settle once per runtime
Chapter markers remain idempotent after ECS reconstruction
Player level-up applies research bonus and returns neutral outbox events
Actor level-up applies bond and configured character points
Prestige spending never reduces earned prestige
Missing prestige state blocks prestige mutations without wallet changes
Income split is deterministic and data driven
Settlement never writes presentation or journal records
Failed system execution rolls every authoritative record back
Actor wallets remain isolated while shared balances settle once
